title: Economic Scarcity as Value: A Universal Framework for Blockchain and Beyond: paper and replication package
description: Working paper and full replication package. A structural valuation framework in which economic scarcity, the monetizable intersection of desirability and constrained access, is the foundation of asset value. Five protocol-level elements (Purpose, Incentives, Consensus, Tokenomics, Network Effects) are mapped to a network value function V = D S (u/u0)^alpha, with a scored physical-scarcity index S, normalized adoption u, and an implied desirability D recovered as the residual of market value. Applied to Bitcoin, Ethereum and Bittensor as of 5 August 2025: Bitcoin and Ethereum carry nearly identical implied desirability per normalized user, while Bittensor's valuation is expectation-dominated. Includes all data, scripts, result tables, figures and tests; the scripts reproduce every number in the paper.
